blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY — Starhorse Shipping Lines Inc. has suspended the acceptance and carriage of electric vehicles (EVs) and hybrid electric vehicles (HEVs) across its fleet, making it the third marine service fleet to raise safety concerns following the September 9 fire on a boat bound for Palawan.
